draft.title: Cause, consequence, continuity and change
card: something that made an event happen. A cause comes before the event.
something that followed from an event. A consequence comes after it.
something that stayed the same over a period of time.
something that became different over a period of time.
draft.remember: Causes come before an event and consequences come after it. Continuity stays the same and change is different.

a.q: A flood ruins the crops of farmers in an ancient valley. Some of them then leave for a nearby town. How should a historian describe the move to the town?
opts: A cause of the farmers' hunger
a.why: The move happened after the flood and followed from it, so it is a consequence. It is not a cause of the flood, because a cause must come before the event it explains.
a.clue: Did the move happen before or after the flood?

b.q: Over 500 years, a village keeps growing barley on its river land. Its homes change from reed huts to mud-brick houses. Which pair is correct?
opts: Farming is continuity and the houses are change
Farming is change and the houses are continuity
Both farming and the houses are continuity
Both farming and the houses are change
b.why: Barley was grown on the river land at the start and at the end of the 500 years, so the farming is continuity. The homes were reed huts at first and mud-brick houses later, so they are change. Both can happen in the same village over the same period.
b.clue: Compare each thing at the start and at the end of the 500 years.

b.best: Farming is continuity and the houses are change
